text:
devon: Noticed a pattern: our SDKs surface 429 as RateLimitError, but only some languages include a structured `retry_after` field. Customers are writing their own parsers for Retry-After header which is messy.

mina: saw this in a support ticket. They retried aggressively and tripped downstream SLOs. :grimacing:

raj: which SDKs lack it? I think python/node expose `retry_after_seconds` on the exception. Go/Java are still string-only?

isabel: correct. Java throws RateLimitException with message = "retry in Xs". Go just returns an error with text. No accessor.

devon: proposal: adopt a consistent error contract across SDKs: fields = ["code","message","http_status","retryable","retry_after_seconds","category"]. Example (pseudostring):
```json
{
  "code":"RATE_LIMIT",
  "message":"Request quota exceeded",
  "http_status":429,
  "retryable":true,
  "retry_after_seconds":10,
  "category":"rate_limit"
}
```

mina: love adding `code` so apps can switch on it rather than parsing text. Also include `category` for broader grouping: ["client_error","server_error","rate_limit","auth","network"].

raj: agree. We should map common statuses: 401/403 -> AUTH (retryable=false), 429 -> RATE_LIMIT (retryable=true, prefer server `Retry-After`), 503/502 -> SERVER_ERROR (retryable=true but best-effort), network blips/connection resets -> NETWORK (retryable=true). For streaming protocol disconnects maybe mark as NETWORK with `transient=true`?

isabel: for language ergonomics:
- Python/Node: typed exception classes with attributes.
- Go: keep `error` but provide `IsRetryable(err)` and `RetryAfter(err)` helpers plus exported types for type assertions.
- Java/Kotlin: checked vs unchecked debate — probably unchecked `RuntimeException` subclasses with getters.

mina: onboarding change: add a short section in quickstart sample app showing correct backoff pseudocode: `if err.retryable: wait(err.retry_after_seconds or exp_backoff())`. Include link to SDK helper utilities.

devon: telemetry ask: SDKs should emit `error.code` and `http_status` in logs/metrics so we can pivot on frequent error codes. Add a tag for `route`/`model` too.

raj: compatibility: we need a migration path. Plan: add fields to exception objects but keep message intact. Documented semantic version bump for breaking changes (if any). PR flow: quick patches for node/python this sprint, go/java follow-ups next sprint.

isabel: also flagging the docs: sample apps and error handling guide. I'll own the docs update and add a snippet for streaming reconnect behavior.

/sdk-bot: Created INF-4412: "SDK error contract: structured fields & helpers for retry/backoff" assigned to @raj. <https://redwood.internal/INF-4412|link> :white_check_mark:

mina: thanks. Raj, can you include tests that assert `Retry-After` header precedence over heuristic? We should ensure server-provided windows win.

raj: yep, adding tests and sample app demo. Filing PR now.
